title: Expose bounded public OSV IDs for actionable Go SCA failures without relaxing security
goal: Make an observed mandatory CHK-SCA-GO known reachable vulnerability actionable by exposing only strictly validated public GO advisory IDs, never untrusted govulncheck symbol, source path, trace, package/module URL or code, without changing the scan or pass/fail decision.
invariants: All reachable findings still cause CHK-SCA-GO FAILURE; no suppression, ignore list, baseline, severity downgrade, scanner parameter change or SCA scope reduction
Only public strict ASCII GO-YYYY-NNNN advisory identifiers, maximum four sorted unique labels, may enter error text; every other raw scanner datum stays private
Malformed/missing IDs remain a blocking generic identifier-unavailable error
No product data, Go toolchain version or dependency changed blindly without exact finding
security_properties: Never echo private import/module path, package, receiver, function, source, traces, URLs or arbitrary OSV text
No secrets or report content in CI diagnostics; original SAST and secret scanners remain unchanged

migration.rationale: Engineering CLI diagnostic display only; no product runtime or schema.

rollback.strategy: Restore generic blocked count without weakening SCA
verification: CHK-SCA-GO still fails on reachable finding

inputs: Security owner E4-SEC-002B-ACTIVATE verified mandatory govulncheck-Go v1.8.0 pipeline
Current PR #195 SHA 6e5daab6d26662ecd2821d8d3c2f2bfefc1aa792 run 39528312160 CHK-SCA-GO FAILURE 1 reachable finding with withheld metadata
outputs: Strictly validated public advisory reference in failed SCA CI on exact HEAD, or identifier-unavailable; actionable module remediation can then be scoped to verified OSV
Unit tests prove identity redaction and no change to fail-closed classification
acceptance_tests: parseGovulncheckStream still returns error and actionable count for a reachable OSV, now safe identifier
Module path, private symbol, package, raw scanner output never appear in error
Malformed/missing labels never leak and never pass
Exact-head engineering kernel failure reports only safe public advisory ID; vulnerability remains block until actual fix
definition_of_ready: Known SCA-blocking reachable finding at PR #195 exact SHA and no OSV in available logs
definition_of_done: New diagnostics source+tests on correct engineering owner, verified exact SHA with no weakening of SCA
Identify actionable OSV and actual affected module/Go fix path before any product acceptance

performance_budget.rationale: String formatting over already-bounded scanner findings in development tool
